headline: Indian IT services showed mixed revenue growth with a few high‑flying performers and modest profit pressure.
summary: Revenue grew across the sector, led by Coforge's 53.6% YoY surge and HCLTech's 11.5% rise. Profit growth was uneven; Infosys and HCLTech posted double‑digit profit gains, while Wipro saw a 1.9% decline. Guidance remained cautious, with Infosys trimming FY27 growth to 1‑2% and HCLTech introducing a 2.5‑4% range. AI contributions were highlighted but quantified only by a few firms.

themes.title: AI‑driven revenue
themes.detail: Several firms cited AI as a growth driver, with Infosys reporting 29% AI revenue growth and HCLTech noting $219 m AI revenue.

themes.title: Margin pressure
themes.detail: Operating margins slipped for some mid‑tier players, while leaders like TCS and HCLTech maintained high margins above 18%.

leaders.why: Revenue jumped 53.6% YoY and EBIT margin guidance was raised to 16%.
Revenue up 11.5% YoY, profit up 21%, and strong AI revenue contribution.

laggards.why: Revenue grew 9.1% YoY but profit fell 1.9% and headcount was reduced.
Revenue growth slowed to 1.5% YoY and profit growth was only 6% while guidance was cut.
